exercises.response: Color isn't just a property of light or paint—it's the language of our shared universe. When I look at my family, a red tie and a green notebook aren't just random choices; they're symbols of how we connect. For me, black represents the deep space between thoughts, allowing us to feel closer than others, while white stands for clarity and fresh beginnings. We create these colors together as partners in this federation.
